links.title: BMC single instance
links.tooltip: Drill down to single server details

targets.expr: count(count by (job, instance, id) (last_over_time(idrac_pcie_device_info{job=~"$job", group=~"$group", instance=~"$instance", manufacturer=~"NVIDIA.*", name!~".*(ConnectX|BlueField|NVSwitch).*"}[$__range])))

count(count by (job, instance) (count by (job, instance, id) (last_over_time(idrac_pcie_device_info{job=~"$job", group=~"$group", instance=~"$instance", manufacturer=~"NVIDIA.*", name!~".*(ConnectX|BlueField|NVSwitch).*"}[$__range]))) != 8) or vector(0)

count((last_over_time(idrac_pcie_device_health{job=~"$job", group=~"$group", instance=~"$instance"}[$__range]) * on (job, instance, id) group_left (name, slot) max by (job, instance, id, name, slot) (last_over_time(idrac_pcie_device_info{job=~"$job", group=~"$group", instance=~"$instance", manufacturer=~"NVIDIA.*", name!~".*(ConnectX|BlueField|NVSwitch).*"}[$__range]))) > 0) or vector(0)

count by (name) (count by (job, instance, id, name) (last_over_time(idrac_pcie_device_info{job=~"$job", group=~"$group", instance=~"$instance", manufacturer=~"NVIDIA.*", name!~".*(ConnectX|BlueField|NVSwitch).*"}[$__range])))

panels.title: Duplicate GPU serials
panels.description: GPU serial numbers reported by more than one device during the selected time range. A GPU moved between hosts within the range also shows up here.

targets.expr: count by (serial) (count by (job, instance, id, serial) (last_over_time(idrac_pcie_device_info{job=~"$job", group=~"$group", instance=~"$instance", manufacturer=~"NVIDIA.*", name!~".*(ConnectX|BlueField|NVSwitch).*", serial!=""}[$__range]))) > 1

sort(count by (instance) (count by (job, instance, id) (last_over_time(idrac_pcie_device_info{job=~"$job", group=~"$group", instance=~"$instance", manufacturer=~"NVIDIA.*", name!~".*(ConnectX|BlueField|NVSwitch).*"}[$__range]))))
